mapper.sql: select s.id, s.user_id, s.snapshot_date, s.weather_code, s.weather_name, s.sky_type, s.cloud_density, s.rain_intensity, s.lightning_intensity, s.wind_speed, s.fog_intensity, s.color_temperature, s.saturation, s.particle_style, s.animation_seed, s.combined_vector, s.record_count, s.create_time, s.create_by, s.update_time, s.update_by, s.del_flag, s.remark, ( select a.ai_summary from biz_mood_record r inner join biz_ai_analysis_result a on a.record_id = r.id and a.del_flag = 0 where r.user_id = s.user_id and date(r.record_time) = date(s.snapshot_date) and r.del_flag = 0 order by r.record_time desc, r.id desc limit 1 ) as ai_summary, ( select a.primary_emotion from biz_mood_record r inner join biz_ai_analysis_result a on a.record_id = r.id and a.del_flag = 0 where r.user_id = s.user_id and date(r.record_time) = date(s.snapshot_date) and r.del_flag = 0 order by r.record_time desc, r.id desc limit 1 ) as primary_emotion, ( select a.secondary_emotion from biz_mood_record r inner join biz_ai_analysis_result a on a.record_id = r.id and a.del_flag = 0 where r.user_id = s.user_id and date(r.record_time) = date(s.snapshot_date) and r.del_flag = 0 order by r.record_time desc, r.id desc limit 1 ) as secondary_emotion, ( select a.scene_recognition from biz_mood_record r inner join biz_ai_analysis_result a on a.record_id = r.id and a.del_flag = 0 where r.user_id = s.user_id and date(r.record_time) = date(s.snapshot_date) and r.del_flag = 0 order by r.record_time desc, r.id desc limit 1 ) as scene_recognition, ( select a.risk_level from biz_mood_record r inner join biz_ai_analysis_result a on a.record_id = r.id and a.del_flag = 0 where r.user_id = s.user_id and date(r.record_time) = date(s.snapshot_date) and r.del_flag = 0 order by r.record_time desc, r.id desc limit 1 ) as risk_level from biz_weather_snapshot s
mapper.select: select avg(v.valence) as avg_valence, avg(v.arousal) as avg_arousal, avg(v.anxiety) as avg_anxiety, avg(v.calmness) as avg_calmness, avg(v.loneliness) as avg_loneliness, avg(v.fatigue) as avg_fatigue, avg(v.anger) as avg_anger, avg(v.hope) as avg_hope, avg(v.confidence) as avg_confidence, count(1) as record_count from biz_mood_record r inner join biz_emotion_vector v on r.id = v.record_id and v.del_flag = 0 where r.user_id = #{userId} and date(r.record_time) = date(#{snapshotDate}) and r.del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: insert into biz_weather_snapshot ( user_id, snapshot_date, weather_code, weather_name, sky_type, cloud_density, rain_intensity, lightning_intensity, wind_speed, fog_intensity, color_temperature, saturation, particle_style, animation_seed, combined_vector, record_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark ) values ( #{userId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{weatherCode}, #{weatherName}, #{skyType}, #{cloudDensity}, #{rainIntensity}, #{lightningIntensity}, #{windSpeed}, #{fogIntensity}, #{colorTemperature}, #{saturation}, #{particleStyle}, #{animationSeed}, #{combinedVector}, #{recordCount}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{delFlag}, #{remark} ) on duplicate key update weather_code = values(weather_code), weather_name = values(weather_name), sky_type = values(sky_type), cloud_density = values(cloud_density), rain_intensity = values(rain_intensity), lightning_intensity = values(lightning_intensity), wind_speed = values(wind_speed), fog_intensity = values(fog_intensity), color_temperature = values(color_temperature), saturation = values(saturation), particle_style = values(particle_style), animation_seed = values(animation_seed), combined_vector = values(combined_vector), record_count = values(record_count), update_by = values(update_by), update_time = values(update_time), del_flag = 0, remark = values(remark)
